science_relevance.scientific_problem: Construct integer sets that improve extremal bounds relating sumset and difference-set cardinalities.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: These constructions determine limits in additive combinatorics. Their significance is a stronger mathematical inequality or counterexample, rather than a general-purpose model score.

papers.title: Sums and Differences of Finite Sets
papers.task_relation: The paper derives the construction exponent 1 + log(|U−U|/|U+U|)/log(2 max U + 1) from a finite nonnegative integer set U containing zero. This is the local construction objective used by SCiEL: Finite-set sum and difference ratio.
papers.primary_goal: Establish sharp relationships and constructive bounds for sizes of finite sumsets and difference sets.

science_relevance.reason: Primary research addresses the underlying problem directly; scientific importance does not rely on the agent/framework paper.
